wholePhysicalScope: Named inn point, street axis and selected outline, exact Qualla photo, two supplemental CC0 exterior photographs and original elevation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the street ranges, pitched roofs, chimneys and courtyard arch. Near levels refine the timber studs and leaded glazing.
limitations: The model represents the principal Mermaid Inn street wings and their inner courtyard in 2019. The shared building row continues into adjoining properties.
The street photographs determine the half-timbering, roof and chimney character. Exact property divisions at the rear, court and steps are approximate.
